_note: A FICTIONAL French IT services SME. No real company, no real certificate, no real insurance policy. The tender packs this tool reads are real public documents; this library is not, and is not meant to resemble any actual firm. See samples/README.md.
_reference_deadline_note: The submission date these dates were chosen against. Every verdict below is relative to it — change it and the whole demonstration changes. Regenerated when a real tender is picked.

profile.activity: Custom software development and application maintenance

documents.name: Extrait Kbis
documents.note: Never expires, but buyers routinely demand one issued less than 3 months ago.

documents.name: Attestation de vigilance URSSAF
documents.note: The document itself never expires. Buyers demand one issued less than 6 months ago — this one is older than that, and will be refused while looking perfectly valid.

documents.name: Attestation de régularité fiscale (DGFiP)
documents.note: Recent enough for the usual 6-month rule.

documents.name: Attestation d'assurance responsabilité civile professionnelle
documents.note: Valid today. Expires nine days before the submission date. This is the case the whole tool exists to catch.

documents.name: Certificat ISO/IEC 27001
documents.note: Three-year cycle, lapsed last month. Nobody re-reads a folder of forty attestations before every bid.

documents.name: Label ExpertCyber
documents.note: Carries an expiry date that could not be read from the document. Not a pass and not a failure — something to go and look at. Reporting this as valid is the failure mode the tool refuses.

documents.name: Bilans et comptes de résultat des trois derniers exercices
Liste de références clients 2023-2026
documents.note: Buyers usually ask for the last three years.

documents.name: Politique de protection des données personnelles
documents.note: Increasingly demanded as an annex in public IT tenders.
